d:
I've been working on this one between other projects for the last month or so and it's finally complete. By volume of text, this is by far the longest work I have translated, and I'm very happy with how it has turned out. That being said, it is quite dense, so I wouldn't be surprised if a spelling error or two slipped under my radar. Feel free to point out any mistakes in the comments and I will be quick to correct them and update the gallery.

I'm a big fan of mononobe's work, and I hope to translate some of their other stuff in the future. I will likely be taking on the "pussy sphere" experiment story next, but it may take me some time to complete, as I will have to work around the schedule of my regular commissions. If you want to see anything by mononobe translated faster, feel free to reach out to me to get it commissioned.
